meta.name: infinitetalk-shopping-avatar
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货视频时，使用本技能可自动生成适配InfiniteTalk的五幕分镜结构化提示词，精准管控角色一致性与音画同步，一键产出高质量9:16竖屏带货视频，让数字人带货更高效！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成数字人五幕分镜，产出竖屏带货视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在运营电商或做内容,需要快速制作数字人带货视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate five-act storyboard prompts for digital human shopping videos.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run e-commerce or create content and need quick digital-human shopping videos.

howto.what: 为 InfiniteTalk 生成小省导购员五幕分镜提示词：每幕 5 秒、总 25 秒、9:16 竖屏 1080×1920，含角色固定特征、帧级动作、场景、音频匹配与光影描述，并输出参数配置表。
howto.when: 当你需要制作小省导购员数字人带货视频、用 InfiniteTalk 推理时会用到；场景可为产品推荐、价格对比、促销活动等。后续还可做质量核查与跨工具集成。

say.text: 帮我生成产品推荐场景的五幕带货提示词，情绪热情专业
say.note: 输出五幕中文提示词和参数配置表

say.text: 核查这份提示词的技术参数和角色一致性，出质检报告
say.note: 通过则归档，不通过列出问题清单

say.text: 把 Suno 音频和参考图对接到 InfiniteTalk 推理流程
say.note: 输出音频编码文件和视频生成结果

howto.what_en: Generates five-act storyboard prompts for the InfiniteTalk shopping-avatar video: 5s per act, 25s total, 9:16 1080x1920, with fixed character features, frame-level actions, scene, audio matching, lighting, plus a parameter table.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need to make a shopping-avatar带货 video and run InfiniteTalk inference; scenes include product recommendation, price comparison, promo campaigns, etc. Quality checks and cross-tool integration follow.

say_en.text: Generate five-act prompts for a product-recommendation video, warm and professional tone
say_en.note: Outputs five-act Chinese prompts and a parameter table

say_en.text: Check this prompt's technical parameters and character consistency, give a QA report
say_en.note: Pass gets archived; fail returns an issue list

say_en.text: Connect Suno audio and the reference image to InfiniteTalk inference
